strategyReview: The Weekend HL Funding Reversion Long remains the engine’s best signal, delivering consistent positive returns across diverse assets (71.6% live win rate, +0.35% avg PnL; shadows 74.3% win). ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO live trades are perfect (4/4) and manual IV-touch rich NO shadows show strong potential (79% win, +11.8% avg). However, the majority of hypothesis-driven setups are failing—cross-asset momentum, BTC PM IV expansion reversion, and GOLD heatmap shadows all produce negligible or negative returns, while live funding extreme signals deteriorate. The system burns test budgets on unviable hypotheses, particularly in BTC correlation and no-bias gap themes.

failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion 0% win (8 tests), btc_pm_iv_expansion_reversion 30% win (10 tests), shadow_one_touch_high_edge_no_gold_heatmap_no 0% win (15 tests), no_bias_adjusted_gap_shadow 42% win (90 shadows). Many active hypotheses have zero wins and no viable edge.
failureClusters.recommendation: Set an auto-kill threshold for hypothesis tests (e.g., 10 consecutive losses). Halt further GOLD heatmap and cross-asset momentum hypotheses; prune families already invalidated by their learned assumptions.

failureClusters.theme: No-Bias Gap & GOLD Heatmap Edge Decay
failureClusters.evidence: NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW resolved 90 shadows with 42% win rate and -1.27% avg PnL; GOLD one-touch heatmap H-534 lost all 15 tests. The underlying-cap edge signal did not translate into spot declines.
failureClusters.recommendation: Suspend all new GOLD one-touch heatmap variants. For gap-based entries, add a trend filter (e.g., spot already below SMA) and require tight spreads and near-expiry contracts.

failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG live trades: 15/34 wins, -0.65% avg PnL, with AMZN (2/7 wins) and HYPE (2/6 wins) particularly poor. Many stops at -2%.
failureClusters.recommendation: Consider disabling AMZN and HYPE within FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG. Alternatively, add a regime filter (funding z-score < -2) to only trade extreme negative funding, not merely positive.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The PM IV absolute threshold of 46 and >8% discount to options IV no longer produces reliable >2% absolute moves. Recent tests show moves below 2% or slight declines. Low absolute PM IV combined with a discount no longer guarantees a volatility breakout.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC PM IV below 46 while options IV remains high guarantees a >2% absolute spot move within 3 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The underlying cap edge ≥10 pts on gold upside touch NO contracts failed to predict >2% spot declines, with all 15 resolved tests losing. The edge often persisted without spot movement; large edge alone does not drive mean reversion.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on gold one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: CBRS weekend funding reversion shadow tests show mixed results; weekday signals often produce whipsaw funding moves that fail to normalize. A weekend-only filter (as in H-588) appears necessary to capture reliable reversion.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Deeply negative weekday CBRS funding reliably reverts, causing a spot bounce without explicit weekend context.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL weekend funding reversion shadows perform poorly on weekdays. The edge only materializes when extreme negative funding occurs on weekends; the hypothesis must be restricted to weekend-only.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Extreme negative AAPL funding any day of the week rapidly normalizes and leads to a spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The AMZN funding convergence hypothesis enters when basis is near zero and funding is slightly positive, but funding stays pinned and does not rise further. The convergence phase is already complete; there is no further upward funding reversion.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Positive funding with near-zero basis still creates a tradeable convergence that pushes funding higher and benefits the long stock position.

journalEntry: Tonight's review confirms the WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG remains the engine's strongest signal and ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO is promising. However, hypothesis-driven families are burning capital and test budgets with near-zero win rates. We invalidated core assumptions in AMZN funding convergence, GOLD heatmap, BTC PM IV expansion, and weekend funding shadows. Ten new testable hypotheses were authored: five from top-ranked shadow findings on PM IV rich and one-touch NO edges, and five refinements that address the diagnosed failures by adding trend, expiry, or weekend-only filters. No parameter updates are warranted at this stage.
